startingCard.title: Kobe Bryant dies
startingCard.subtitle: American basketball player
startingCard.fact: Kobe Bean Bryant was an American professional basketball player.

cards.title: ‘Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus’ is published
cards.subtitle: Book by Mary Shelley
cards.fact: Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus is an 1818 Gothic novel written by English author Mary Shelley.

cards.title: Christian VI of Denmark becomes king of Denmark
cards.fact: Christian VI was King of Denmark and Norway from 1730 to 1746.

cards.title: ‘Titan Quest’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Iron Lore Entertainment
cards.fact: Titan Quest is a 2006 action role-playing game developed by Iron Lore Entertainment and published by THQ for Windows, first physically and then in 2007 through Steam.

cards.title: National Theatre in Belgrade is completed
cards.subtitle: Theatre in Belgrade, Serbia
cards.fact: The National Theatre is a theatre located in Belgrade, Serbia.

cards.title: Aeroflot is founded
cards.subtitle: Airline
cards.fact: PJSC Aeroflot – Russian Airlines, commonly known as Aeroflot, is the flag carrier and the largest airline of Russia.

cards.title: Finnair is founded
cards.subtitle: Airline
cards.fact: Finnair Plc is the flag carrier and largest full-service legacy airline of Finland, with headquarters in Vantaa on the grounds of Helsinki Airport, its hub.

cards.title: ‘Gears 5’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by The Coalition
cards.fact: Gears 5 is a 2019 third-person shooter video game developed by The Coalition and published by Xbox Game Studios for Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S.

cards.title: War of the Spanish Succession begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The War of the Spanish Succession was a European great power conflict, fought between 1701 and 1714.

cards.title: ‘Casablanca’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Michael Curtiz
cards.fact: Casablanca is a 1942 American romantic drama film directed by Michael Curtiz and starring Humphrey Bogart, Ingrid Bergman, and Paul Henreid.

cards.title: Blue1 is founded
cards.subtitle: Airline
cards.fact: Blue1 Oy was a Finnish airline owned by CityJet.

cards.title: Dunlop Tyres is founded
cards.subtitle: International tyre brand
cards.fact: Dunlop is a brand of tyres, currently owned and produced by the Japanese company Sumitomo Rubber Industries.

cards.title: Neo-Babylonian Empire is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The Neo-Babylonian Empire or Second Babylonian Empire, historically known as the Chaldean Empire, was the last polity ruled by monarchs native to ancient Mesopotamia.

cards.title: ‘The Return of the Prodigal Son’ is painted
cards.subtitle: Painting by Rembrandt
cards.fact: The Return of the Prodigal Son is an oil painting by Rembrandt, part of the collection of the Hermitage Museum in St.

cards.title: Felipe VI of Spain becomes king of Spain
cards.fact: Felipe VI is King of Spain, having reigned since 19 June 2014.

cards.title: Spanish American wars of independence begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The Spanish American wars of independence were a series of conflicts fought across Spanish America during the early 19th century.

cards.title: 23 Marina is completed
cards.subtitle: Dubai skyscraper
cards.fact: 23 Marina is an 88-story, 392.8 m (1,289 ft) residential skyscraper in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

cards.title: Manchester City F.C. is founded
cards.subtitle: Football club
cards.fact: Manchester City Football Club is a professional football club based in Manchester, England, that competes in the Premier League, the top flight of English football.

cards.title: ‘Anora’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Sean Baker
cards.fact: Anora is a 2024 American romantic comedy-drama film written, directed, produced, and edited by Sean Baker.

cards.title: ‘Saving Private Ryan’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Steven Spielberg
cards.fact: Saving Private Ryan is a 1998 American epic war film directed by Steven Spielberg and written by Robert Rodat.

cards.title: ‘Heat’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Michael Mann
cards.fact: Heat is a 1995 American crime drama film written and directed by Michael Mann.

cards.title: Vickers MBT enters service
cards.subtitle: Main battle tank family
cards.fact: The Vickers MBT is a series of main battle tanks (MBTs) developed as a private venture by British company Vickers-Armstrongs for export.

cards.title: James Stewart dies
cards.subtitle: American actor
cards.fact: James Maitland Stewart was an American actor and military aviator.

cards.title: Second Boer War begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The Second Boer War, also known as the Boer War, Transvaal War, Anglo–Boer War, or the South African War, was a conflict fought between the British Empire and the Boer republics over Britain's influence in Southern Africa.

cards.title: SMK tank enters service
cards.subtitle: Heavy tank
cards.fact: The SMK was an armored vehicle prototype developed by the Soviet Union prior to the Second World War.

cards.title: Ada Lovelace dies
cards.subtitle: English mathematician
cards.fact: Augusta Ada King, Countess of Lovelace, also known as Ada Lovelace, was an English mathematician and writer chiefly known for work on Charles Babbage's proposed mechanical general-purpose computer, the analytical engine.

cards.title: San Damiano is completed
cards.subtitle: Church in Assisi, Italy
cards.fact: San Damiano is a church with a monastery near Assisi, Italy.

cards.title: ‘Alone in the Dark 2’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Infogrames
cards.fact: Alone in the Dark 2 is a 1993 survival horror video game developed and published by Infogrames.

cards.title: ‘Devdas’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Sanjay Leela Bhansali
cards.fact: Devdas is a 2002 Indian Hindi-language period romantic drama film directed by Sanjay Leela Bhansali and produced by Bharat Shah under his banner, Mega Bollywood.

cards.title: ‘God of War II’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Santa Monica Studio
cards.fact: God of War II is a 2007 action-adventure game developed by Santa Monica Studio and published by Sony Computer Entertainment (SCE).

cards.title: Palau Güell is completed
cards.subtitle: Mansion in Barcelona, Spain, designed by Antoni Gaudi
cards.fact: The Palau Güell is a mansion designed by the architect Antoni Gaudí for the industrial tycoon Eusebi Güell, and was built between 1886 and 1888.
